main_text.p: pyramidis (nam quo magis defcenditur, latera diftant magis) ergo bafis, quæ vl- tima eft, debet effe cæteris longior, quod non contingit in dato cafu. Adeft exem- plum in hac pyramide.
main_text.l: [Triangle diagram with apex O, horizontal lines labelled C and B, base labelled A]
main_text.p: Refpond. negando fuppofitum. Ratio eft, quia non poteft conftrui pyramis exa- ctè, ac mathematicè perfecta, in qua li- nea bafis minor fit lateralibus. Probatur, nam laterales in rigore mathematico de- bent fic protendi, vt quanto magis de- fcendunt à cuspide, tanto magis recedant à se: at defcenfus à cuspide fit per omne punctum, ergo per omne punctum rece- dere debent à se. Ponamus igitur quòd latera defcendant per affignata viginti puncta; ergo illa in extremis diftabunt ab invicem 20. punctis; vnde linea bafis a. erit 20. punctorum; fuperior b. 19. c. 18. &c.
